title: Solving 20 Erdős Problems with 20 Codex Accounts Running in Parallel
summary: An experimental project demonstrating how 20 OpenAI Codex accounts running in parallel can collaboratively solve challenging mathematical problems from Paul Erdős's collection, showcasing the potential of multi-agent AI systems for tackling complex reasoning tasks.
problem_solved: Demonstrates how AI agents working in parallel can solve sophisticated mathematical problems that typically require human expertise.
why_valuable: Provides empirical evidence of scaling AI reasoning capabilities through parallel agent architectures for complex problem-solving tasks.
